annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably trusting that someone upstream made sure the line was clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: trusting that someone upstream made sure the line was clear
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That trust is exactly why I'd keep yelling and waving at them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: That lone worker likely thinks he picked the quiet spot
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: If he believes he's safe, he won't be watching.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: So I'd be gesturing wildly toward him too

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Each of those six is assuming this is an ordinary shift.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: while I hesitate I'd be waving at whoever's closest

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: He's trusting nobody would steer trouble toward him.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: has no reason to think anything is coming his way
annotations.pda_responsibility: I know waiting is a choice too.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the rest of that crew is going to believe someone let them down
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd go to them and explain exactly what I saw and did
annotations.ce_supportive_use: That's why, if I got through it, I'd go to them and explain

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: A signal operator might assume the train is still parked up top.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: pounding on the nearest window, because they'd surely want to know
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I don't trust myself to get it right in a panic.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Those five think the line's dead today.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Why else would they be kneeling there?
annotations.ce_supportive_use: So I'd wave like mad the whole time I'm stalling

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Lord, I'd want to hand this to somebody else.
annotations.pda_responsibility: Pulling makes it my doing, and not pulling feels like standing by.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The lone worker probably imagines he's out of the way on a siding.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Knowing that, I'd point straight at him while I'm hesitating

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'd expect anyone nearby to at least try
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: I've worked alongside crews like that.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: So I'd be moving, waving, flashing my phone light

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the five feel responsible for each other
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If even one spotted me jumping around, he'd pull the others clear.
